Agent Name: Planner

Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely hypothesized that Shirley Temple held the position of "United States Chief of Protocol" as a "Secondary/confirming target" in its instructions to the WebSurfer. This was an error of hallucination and lack of verification; Shirley Temple served as the U.S. Ambassador to Ghana (1974–1976), but she never served as the U.S. Chief of Protocol (that role was held by individuals like George Shultz and William Scranton). By including this incorrect title in the search plan, the Planner introduced a false premise into the investigation, leading to redundant and misleading search queries that did not align with the actual facts of the actress's career.
